The '''Compound Flex-5 Detonite Tape''' was a plastic adhesive explosive manufactured by [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.]] The tape was embedded with [[Detonite/Legends|detonite]] and produced in five-[[Meter/Legends|meter]] rolls. It was a stabled explosive which required either intense heat or an electrical charge to detonate. Flexible and adhesive, Compound Flex-5 Detonite Tape could be applied in various shapes, allowing for precise explosions such as blowing hatches and hull-plates.<ref name="Ship Jackers" />
